description: This bar chart illustrates the GPU memory usage for different fine-tuning methods. The horizontal axis displays the method names – Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA, and Ours – presented in a non-alphabetical, non-descending order, and is labeled “”. The vertical axis, labeled “GPU Memory (GB)”, represents the memory usage in gigabytes, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, and tick marks at 0, 20, 40, and 60.  There are five orange bars and one green bar representing each method. The “Full FT” bar is the tallest, reaching approximately 68 GB. The “MTL-FT” bar extends to approximately 40 GB, while the “TAG” bar reaches approximately 20 GB. The “LoRA” bar is approximately 20 GB in height, and the “QLoRA” bar is approximately 10 GB. Finally, the “Ours” bar, colored green, reaches approximately 20 GB. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
